name: Xjena
source: Xjena is the main character of "Women of Xal" and is one of the Apprentices chosen by Lady Xuna to compete for the Matriarch title. Xjena is a seer who can look into the future to choose the best possible outcome in any scenario, although use of her powers drains her energy. She has also visited Earth and is familiar with human society.
